children: Led the fundamental strategic pivot from a software-centric to a cloud-first, AI-first company.
Directed the massive-scale expansion of Microsoft Azure, making it a global leader in cloud services.
Integrated generative AI across the entire Microsoft product stack, including Windows, Office, and Bing.
Orchestrated multi-billion dollar strategic acquisitions and partnerships, including OpenAI.
Drove massive revenue growth through subscription-based cloud and enterprise services.
Empowered organizations of all sizes through scalable and secure cloud solutions.
Built a robust ecosystem of developers and partners around Azure and Microsoft 365.
Fostered a culture of 'growth mindset' to drive innovation and continuous learning.
Headed the Cloud and Enterprise group, driving the adoption of cloud-based services.
Developed the vision and strategy for Microsoft's enterprise-scale cloud offerings.
Managed large-scale engineering and sales teams to achieve global market dominance.

projects.title: Azure Cloud Infrastructure
projects.subtitle: Global Cloud Platform
bullets: Directed the build-out of one of the world's largest and most resilient cloud computing platforms.
Enabled global-scale enterprise computing through distributed systems and high-availability architecture.
Scaled Azure to serve millions of concurrent users and massive-scale workloads.

projects.title: AI Integration Ecosystem
projects.subtitle: Generative AI for Enterprise
bullets: Led the integration of large language models into Microsoft 365 and GitHub Copilot.
Created a seamless experience for developers and business users through AI-driven productivity tools.
Established Microsoft as the premier partner for enterprise-ready generative AI.

activities.title: Global Tech Leadership
activities.subtitle: Industry Advocacy
bullets: Advocating for the responsible and ethical deployment of AI at scale.
Promoting cloud computing as a driver for digital transformation and economic growth.
Speaking at major global technology conferences on the future of computing.

publications.title: Hit Refresh
publications.subtitle: Leadership Memoir
bullets: A reflection on Microsoft's transformation and the importance of culture and purpose.
